newsitem.title: USA: D.H. Marketing raises Q1 EPS estimate.
newsitem.headline: D.H. Marketing raises Q1 EPS estimate.

text.p: D.H. Marketing & Consulting Inc on Friday said it was raising its pretax earnings estimate for the first quarter to $0.60 a share from $0.50.
The company also said it planned a three-for-one stock split.
The company posted earnings per share of $0.04 in the first quarter of 1996 and $0.40 in the fourth quarter.

A spokesman said the company was raising its estimate because it closed a number of deals sooner than expected. D.H. Marketing sells collectibles and other tangible assets to private investors and corporations.
It said the stock split would give shareholders of record on February 24 two additional shares for each one held on February 25.
The split is part of its effort to meet the regulatory requirements for a NASDAQ Small Cap listing, it added.
The company will have about 3.8 million shares outstanding after the split, it added.
